No design-vs-spec conflict (plan-spec requires `tits-cones-chambers-and-parabolic-stabilizers`, same as the design); the recorded deviations are the minimal honest `deps` sets (the page prerequisite is genuinely consumed via `thm-cg-dual-chamber-intersections-and-point-stabilizers`) and the chosen route for "positive definite ⟹ finite" (dual chamber isolation + choice-free Heine-Borel, no spherical developing map). No Choice is used anywhere.
